Completion Check

A simple script to check what jobs in the original parameter-file original_parameters.txt finished (i.e. had results written to csv-file). The script generates a new parameter.txt listing the missing jobs for a new array job.

slurm.completion_check.run_completion_check()[source]
slurm.completion_check.summarize_results(result_file='./results/results.csv')[source]

Function that counts how many lines there are in result_file for every prior parameter and value.

result_file (str): Filename and path of csv file to summarize.
